blurb: Dive Santa Barbara offers scuba diving courses including PADI Open Water and Advanced Open Water certifications, guided dives around the Channel Islands, and a large rental department with high quality SCUBPRO gear. They provide regulator repair and service, and employ PADI Certified Divemasters for guided dives. Courses include pool and ocean dives, with boat trips to the Channel Islands Marine Sanctuary.
